（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. D. 5682 REGISTRY. Mr. Denny Date 24/4/34）

Subject (in full) Arrest of a communist suspect named Tsang Vung Lih (曾文禮)
alias Tsang Tsung Hwa (曾仲華) on Annam Road on 13.2.34.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by J.B.Lu. O.I.

Relating to the attached file, I have to report
that despite diligent enquiries made into this case from the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau either through Supt. Tan Shao-liang
or by this office, no fresh development has so far transpired.
It is gathered that the Chinese Authorities, who have been
unable to furnish any more conclusive evidence, are assuming
a pessimistic attitude over the decision rendered by the court
on 14.3.34.

Enquiries show that the shop security which was
furnished by Tsang Yoong Sung (楊榮生), proprietor of the Van
Sung Kong (萬生康) Grocery Store, 102 Hupeh Road, has been
accepted by the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court.
In view of the foregoing circumstances, I
respectfully suggest that the papers relating to this case
be filed pending receipt of further information from the
Public Safety Bureau who, it is reported have applied to
Nanking for instructions.

日期 1934年4月24日

（印：上海公共租界工部局 档案号 D. 5682 登记处。丹尼先生 日期 34年4月24日）

主题（全称） 1934年2月13日在安南路逮捕一名名为曾文禮（Tsang Vung Lih）、别名曾仲華（Tsang Tsung Hwa）的共产党嫌疑犯。
由督察顾保华（Kuh Pao-hwa）呈报，经高级督察陆金宝（J.B.Lu）转呈。

关于所附卷宗，本人须报告称，尽管通过谭绍良警司或经由本办公室向上海市公安局进行了勤勉查询，但截至目前，本案尚无新进展。据悉，中国当局因无法提供更具决定性的证据，对法院于1934年3月14日作出的裁决持悲观态度。

查询显示，湖北路102号万生康杂货店店主杨荣生（Tsang Yoong Sung）提供的铺保，已被江苏高等法院第二分院接受。鉴于上述情况，本人谨建议将本案相关文件归档，待从 reportedly 已向南京请示指令的市公安局收到进一步消息后再行处理。

Proceedings. Mr T.Y.Cheng appeared for the Shanghai Municipal Council.

Counsels as previous appeared for the Accused.

Judge Yoch, handed a reply from Peiping to the counsel

Judge Yoch, to Mr Cheng:- What is the opinion of the
Shanghai Municipal Council, regarding the handing over of the accused to the S.P.S.B.

Mr Chang:- The documents seized on the person of the
accused, and the statements of the Ex-communist all tend to prove
the guilt of the accused, but Your Honour will please investigate
carefully as to whether or not they constitute the so called
Prima Facie evidence. The unlawful way of arresting the accused
suggests many doubtful points as to whether or not the said documents and statements are genuine. The Shanghai Municipal Council
object to the accused being handed over to the S.P.S.B.

SUMMING UP.

Prosecutor Tseng:- The evidence in this case is not
strong enough to warrant the accused being handed over to the
S.P.S.B.

Kong Zen Nyi wit:- I did not ask the C.D.C. to search
the accused at the Police Station. I am not a second to Daung Fan,
I am employed as a private detective to the Central Government. I
was alone when the accused was arrested. The accused attempted to
escape and in doing so fell on the ground.

DECISION.
It is not necessary to hand over the accused.
Accused to be released on security.

康寿年（康寿年）称他是南市公安局特别分部的特工。根据公安局逮捕的一名所谓共产党员提供的情报，他于 1934 年 2 月 13 日下午 1 时 40 分前往安南路赴约，该约会是由被捕者与另一名所谓共产党员安排的，后者定于 1934 年 2 月 13 日下午 2 时到达此地。当天下午 2 时左右，当他在安南路进行监视时，发现一名中国男子，符合约定见面者的描述（即一名手部有伤的男子）。他对该人进行监视并跟踪。后者发现被跟踪后开始逃跑，但该特工展开追捕并扣留嫌疑人，直至警察到达。

Tsang Vung Lih(張文烈)
Shanse D.S. Jones
B'well Stn Feb. 13, 1934, Clerk Fang Kuo Liang

My name is Tsang Vung Lih (張文烈) alias Tsang Tsung Hwa(張仲華), age 24. My father, Tsang Sz Chih(張樹幟), was Garrison Commander of Tatungfu(大同府), Shanse, for seven years. He resigned in 1924. He is now Advisor to the Military Affairs Committee for Shanse and Suiyuan provinces.

I was born at Tung Er Dao Ka(東二道街), Tsing Ying (精營), Taiyuanfu. At the age of six I left Taiyuanfu with my father and went to live at Tatungfu. From the age of eight to thirteen years I studied at the Lan Da(蘭池) Primary School in that town. I then returned to Taiyuanfu and lived with relatives for one year at No.38 Si Phi Ka(西邊街), Tsing Ying, Taiyuanfu. At the age of 14 years I entered the Tsoong Zuh (崇實) Middle School, Taiyuanfu, and remained at this school for one year. An illness obliged me to leave that school after one year's studies and I remained at home with relatives for another year. When I was sixteen I went to Peiping and became a student of the Tsoong Zuh(崇實) Missionary School, a branch of the one in Taiyuanfu. I remained at this school for 18 months and then left for Tungchow, Hopei. There I studied for three and half years at Loo Ho(潞河) Senior Middle School. I graduated at the age of 21 and then returned to Peiping. For the next 18 months, until April 1933, I followed the lectures given at the Peiping University.

On May 1, 1933 I came to Shanghai alone and went to live with a friend named Li Saung Kyih(李湘己) at the Chiao Tung(交通) Boarding House in Wenchow Road. I stayed there until the beginning of August. Then, for about one month I

山西 D.S. Jones

我叫张文烈（Tsang Vung Lih），别名张仲华（Tsang Tsung Hwa），现年24岁。家父张树帜（Tsang Sz Chih），曾任山西大同府驻军司令七年。他于1924年辞职。现任山西及绥远两省军事委员会顾问。

我出生于太原府精营东二道街。六岁时随父亲离开太原府，前往大同府居住。八岁至十三岁期间，我在该镇的兰池（Lan Da）(音译)小学就读。随后返回太原府，在太原府精营西边街38号的亲戚家居住了一年。十四岁时，我进入太原府崇实（Tsoong Zuh）中学，在该校就读一年。因病在就读一年后不得不离校，又在亲戚家闲居了一年。十六岁时前往北平，成为崇实（Tsoong Zuh）教会学校的学生，该校是太原府崇实学校的分校。我在该校就读十八个月后，前往河北通州。在那里，我在潞河（Loo Ho）高中学习了三年半。二十一岁毕业，随后返回北平。在接下来的十八个月里，直至1933年4月，我一直在北京大学旁听。

1933年5月1日，我独自来到上海，与一位名叫李湘己（Li Saung Kyih）(音译)的朋友住在温州路的交通大学宿舍。我住到八月初。之后，大约有一个月时间，我

lived with a friend named Zi Zung Ziang(徐仁祥) at the Nanyang
University, Chinese territory. In September last year I joined
the Futan University, Kiangwan. I lived at the university
until the 21st of last month and then, as the university closed
for the winter vacation, I went to reside with a friend of my
father named Jau Hyi Tsah(喬宜) at No.35 Yu Yuen Hsin Tshung
(愚園新邨), Yu Yuen Road.

This afternoon as I was walking along Annam Road
three men came up and began to assault me. I called for help
and 2 policemen, one forei and one Chinese came on the scene.
The Chinese policeman escorted me and one of my aggressors to
Bubbling Well Station. The other two men were allowed to
proceed on their way. At the Station I was accused of being
a communist.

I am not a communist, neither do I belong to any
political party.

I cannot account for the communistic documents
found on my person. They do not belong to me. Possibly they
were placed in my pocket by the Public Safety Bureau informer
when he was assaulting me.

(Signed) Tsang Vung Lih.

与中国地界的南洋大学一位名叫徐仁祥（Zi Zung Ziang）(音译)的朋友同住。去年九月，我进入江湾的复旦大学。我一直住在校内，直到上月21日，因学校放寒假，我便去投奔父亲的一位朋友乔宜（Jau Hyi Tsah）(音译)，居住在愚园路愚园新邨35号。

今天下午，当我走在安南路上时，三名男子上前开始殴打我。我呼救，两名警察，一名外籍和一名华警，赶到现场。华警将我和其中一名施暴者护送至静安寺捕房。另外两人被放行。在捕房，我被指控为共产党员。

我不是共产党员，也不属于任何政党。

我无法解释在我身上发现的共产主义文件。它们不属于我。可能是公安局的线人在殴打我时塞进我的口袋里的。

（签名）张文烈
